svg.aria-label: Landscape: how decisions are made, tools and standards
svg.text: Landscape: how decisions are made, tools and standards
wardley map, draft, made 2026-11-23T22:01Z by cartographer.d@AgentiCCells.dinis from 2 sources (see the JSON)

circle.title: Holacracy Constitution (source: landscape) Rule set for running an organisation through roles with purposes, domains and accountabilities inside nested circles; current version stated is 5.0. Price: not read. https://www.holacracy.org/constitution (read 2026-11-23)

Consent decision-making (Sociocracy 3.0) (source: landscape) Facilitated process in nine steps where only objections block a proposal; unproven concerns are recorded and revisited with the policy's evaluation criteria. Price: not read. https://patterns.sociocracy30.org/consent-decision-making.html (read 2026-11-23)

Bain RAPID (source: landscape) Bain's decision tool assigning Recommend, Agree, Perform, Input and Decide roles so accountability for each decision is clear. Price: not read. https://www.bain.com/insights/rapid-tool-to-clarify-decision-accountability/ (read 2026-11-23)

RACI (source: landscape) Responsibility matrix technique with Responsible, Accountable, Consulted and Informed roles, often used in cross-department projects. Price: not read. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Responsibility_assignment_matrix (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

Loomio (source: landscape) Tool for groups to discuss proposals, vote and record outcomes together, keeping reasons with the decision. Price: Hosted plans in USD: Starter from about 29 to 39 per month or 299 to 399 per year, Pro about 49 to 99 per month, 14-day trial; the page was ambiguous on which figures apply to commercial or nonprofit; Private Loomio is quote-only.. https://github.com/loomio/loomio (read 2026-11-23)

Decidim (source: landscape) Participatory democracy framework for cities and organisations with proposals, assemblies, participatory budgets, surveys and accountability components; first built for Barcelona's city government. Price: not read. https://github.com/decidim/decidim (read 2026-11-23)

CONSUL Democracy (source: landscape) Open source citizen participation and open government software, first used for Madrid city's decide.madrid.es in 2015, maintained with the CONSUL DEMOCRACY Foundation. Price: not read. https://github.com/consuldemocracy/consuldemocracy (read 2026-11-23)

Cloverpop (source: landscape) Enterprise decision intelligence platform that structures, tracks and improves business decisions with AI assistants; customers listed include Google, General Motors, P&G, J&J and Mondelez. Price: No price stated; request-a-demo only.. https://www.cloverpop.com/ (read 2026-11-23)

Aera Technology (source: landscape) Decision intelligence platform whose Aera Skills automate decisions in supply chain, finance, HR and other functions; customers listed include ExxonMobil, Unilever, Merck and Dell. Price: No price or deployment model stated; schedule-a-demo only.. https://www.aeratechnology.com/ (read 2026-11-23)

ADR (adr.github.io) (source: landscape) Community site explaining Architectural Decision Records, each capturing one architecture decision with its rationale and consequences; together they form a decision log. Price: not read. https://adr.github.io/ (read 2026-11-23)

MADR (source: landscape) Markdown ADR template set (four variants: full, minimal, bare, bare-minimal) copied into docs/decisions as nnnn-title.md. Price: not read. https://github.com/adr/madr (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

Log4brains (source: landscape) Docs-as-code tool for writing and publishing ADRs as Markdown in a git repo, with local preview, search, timeline and a static site build. Price: not read. https://github.com/thomvaill/log4brains (read 2026-11-23)

HumanLayer (source: landscape) Runs coding agents (Claude Code, Codex and others) on a team's machines and lets the team steer tasks, sessions, plans and reviews from one place; repo is tagged human-in-the-loop. Price: not read. https://github.com/humanlayer/humanlayer (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

LangGraph interrupts (source: landscape) An interrupt() call pauses an agent graph, saves state, and resumes with a human's value (for example true or false) on the same thread; it can sit inside a tool so each call needs approval, and the reviewer can edit arguments. Price: not read. https://docs.langchain.com/oss/python/langgraph/interrupts (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

Permit.io agent approvals (source: landscape) Docs page for agent security and approvals returned HTTP 404, so nothing was read. Price: not read. https://docs.permit.io/agent-security/overview (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

DMN (OMG standard) (source: landscape) Decision Model and Notation is OMG's standard for graphical decision models plus an executable expression language, designed to work with BPMN and exchange as XML. Price: not read. https://www.omg.org/spec/DMN/ (read 2026-11-23)

Drools (Apache KIE) (source: landscape) Java rule engine that also includes a DMN engine running models with FEEL expressions; Kogito can deploy DMN decisions as microservices. Price: not read. https://github.com/apache/incubator-kie-drools (read 2026-11-23)

Camunda 8 (source: landscape) Agentic orchestration platform combining BPMN flows, DMN decisions and AI agent steps, with Tasklist for human tasks and Operate for monitoring. Price: No prices shown; 30-day free SaaS trial, then free modeling-only account or paid Enterprise; self-managed is free for development and needs an Enterprise licence in production; enterprise quotes via sales.. https://github.com/camunda/camunda (read 2026-11-23)

Open Policy Agent (source: landscape) General-purpose policy engine: services send queries, OPA evaluates rules against data and returns allow or deny decisions for the service to enforce. Price: not read. https://github.com/open-policy-agent/opa (read 2026-11-23); flagged by landscape.d: a page failed or was not read, low confidence

Cedar (source: landscape) Policy language and Rust engine for fine-grained application authorization: a request of principal, action and resource is evaluated against policies and returns allow or deny. Price: not read. https://github.com/cedar-policy/cedar (read 2026-11-23)

svg.text: Green: user need. Purple: the shared goal. Blue: component. Red ring: a gap (named as missing in the sources). Orange arrow: a suggested move, for strategy.d. Faint dashed: low confidence. Positions are a reading of the sources.
